sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 232 (all pages via campsitePaging.do, 236 of 239 campsites parsed)

values.note: ReserveAmerica or 1-800-456-2267, up to 9 months ahead, same day included for campsites. A 1-night campsite stay can be booked within 3 days of arrival. Maximum 14 continuous nights, then 48 hours away before registering again. Check in at the park office before occupying the site.

booking.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sampson-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=232 (Booking Window: Campsite 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 9 Month(s) in advance'; 'Looking to reserve for just 1 night? If you make your reservation within 3 days of your arrival you can book a 1-night stay online or through the Call Center. This applies to campsites only.'; LENGTH OF STAY 'maximum of 14 continuous nights'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2027: all sites close for the annual dog show September 27 - October 6, and Loops 3 and 4 for the Tin Can Rally September 16-19.

season.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sampson-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=232 ('Campsites (All Loops): Friday, May 21, 2027 - Sunday, October 10, 2027'; 'TIN CAN RALLY (Loops 3 & 4 Closed): Thursday, September 16, 2027 - Saturday, September 19, 2027'; 'ANNUAL DOG SHOW (All Sites Closed): Monday, September 27, 2027 - Wednesday, October 6, 2027'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Every campsite has electric, 30- and 20-amp (three listed at 15-amp); electric boxes can be up to 50 ft from the pad, so bring a heavy extension cord.

hookups.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sampson-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=232 ('The park has 243 electric sites located in Loops 1-5 with both 30 and 20 amp service ... Please bring a heavy extension cord. Distances between electric boxes and site pad can be as much as 50 feet') + site list ('Electric Hookup available: 30 amp' 233, '15 amp' 3; 'Full Hookup - no' 236), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 243 electric campsites in five wooded loops (ReserveAmerica lists 239), plus 10 cottages; gravel pads, nearly all listed as 40-ft back-ins. Loop 5 is closest to the lake.

sites.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sampson-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=232 ('243 electric campsites located in five wooded camping loops'; 'Campsite (239)', 'Cottage (10)'; 'Loop 5 is the closest to the lake, with prime sites that have lake views') + site list (Equip length/Driveway '40 Back-In' 227, '30 Back-In' 8, 'Back-In' 1; no pull-throughs), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://newyorkstateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/sampson-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=NY&parkId=232 ('five wooded camping loops each with its own shower/restroom facility'; 'a restaurant/camp store'; Services and Amenities 'Dump Station', 'Convenience Store'), read 2026-10-21

note: Large NY state park on the eastern shore of Seneca Lake; Loop 5 is closest to the lake, with lake-view sites. Marina next door. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on ReserveAmerica (parkId 232): reservable (state:NY row, now on the entry), every site electric (20/30-amp, as the fee note says), 2027 season May 21 - Oct 10 (matches). Added 9-month window, 2-night minimum waived within 3 days, 14-night max, dog-show/rally closures, 243 sites (40-ft back-ins, no pull-throughs), showers, dump, camp store. Fees left as read 2026-10-12. Note corrected: the page puts Loop 5's lake-view sites closest to the lake rather than sites along the shore.
